source: every word of the N5, N4, N3 and N1 lists read by nine Opus reviewers, 27 Nov 2026

gloss.N1:一気/いっき: in one go, at a stretch
gloss.N1:掲げる/かかげる: to hoist, to hold up (a goal)
gloss.N1:他方/たほう: the other side, on the other hand
gloss.N1:振り返る/ふりかえる: to look back, to turn around
gloss.N1:徹する/てっする: to devote oneself to, to stick to
gloss.N1:打ち込む/うちこむ: to drive in, to devote oneself
gloss.N1:帯びる/おびる: to take on (a quality), to carry
gloss.N1:漏らす/もらす: to leak, to let slip (a secret)
gloss.N1:折り返す/おりかえす: to turn back, to call back
gloss.N1:軒並み/のきなみ: across the board, row of houses
gloss.N1:凝る/こる: to be into (something), to get stiff
gloss.N1:取り締まる/とりしまる: to crack down on, to regulate
gloss.N1:澄ます/すます: to strain (one's ears), to look prim
gloss.N1:かぶれる/かぶれる: to get a rash, to be influenced by
gloss.N1:構える/かまえる: to set up (a shop), to take a stance
gloss.N1:こだわる/こだわる: to be particular about, to fuss over
gloss.N1:とりあえず/とりあえず: for now, for the time being
gloss.N1:はまる/はまる: to fit, to get hooked on
gloss.N1:持てる/もてる: to be popular, to be able to hold
gloss.N1:はげる/はげる: to peel off, to go bald
gloss.N3:一方/いっぽう: one side, on the other hand
gloss.N3:応じる/おうじる: to respond to, to comply with
gloss.N3:備える/そなえる: to prepare for, to equip with
gloss.N3:寄せる/よせる: to bring near, to draw close
gloss.N3:乗せる/のせる: to give a ride, to place on
gloss.N3:組む/くむ: to cross (arms, legs), to team up
gloss.N3:写る/うつる: to be photographed, to show (in a photo)
gloss.N3:映る/うつる: to be reflected, to appear (on screen)
gloss.N3:対する/たいする: to face, to be directed toward
gloss.N3:片付く/かたづく: to be tidied up, to be settled
gloss.N3:通じる/つうじる: to be understood, to lead to
gloss.N3:溺れる/おぼれる: to drown, to be addicted to
gloss.N3:載る/のる: to appear (in print), to be placed on
gloss.N3:まとまる/まとまる: to come together, to be settled
gloss.N4:ため/ため: for the sake of, because of
gloss.N4:おいでになる/おいでになる: to come, to go, to be (honorific)
gloss.N4:頑張る/がんばる: to do one's best, to persevere
gloss.N5:降りる/おりる: to get off, to go down
gloss.N5:休む/やすむ: to rest, to take a day off
gloss.N5:起きる/おきる: to get up, to wake up

drop.N1:おす/おす: kana alone: read as 押す (to push) far more often than 'male'
drop.N1:有/ゆう: alone it is rare; learners meet 有 only in compounds
drop.N1:実/じつ: alone 実 is read み (fruit) as often; じつ lives in 実は and compounds
drop.N1:症/しょう: a suffix, not a standalone word
drop.N1:宗/しゅう: rare alone; learners meet it in compounds (宗教, 宗派)
drop.N1:札/ふだ: alone 札 is read さつ (banknote) as often as ふだ
drop.N1:値/あたい: alone 値 is read ね (price) as often; the two senses differ
drop.N1:心中/しんじゅう: also read しんちゅう 'inner feelings'; the word alone cannot say which
drop.N1:大家/たいか: also read おおや 'landlord', the commoner sense; the word alone cannot say which
drop.N1:掛け/かけ: alone ambiguous: credit sale, かけそば, the ~掛け suffix are all common
drop.N1:むら/むら: kana alone: heard, むら is 村 'village' first
drop.N1:大部/たいぶ: rare; learners read 大部 as だいぶ 'considerably'
drop.N1:イエス/イエス: kana alone: also Jesus, and はい is what learners say for yes
drop.N1:いやいや/いやいや: kana alone: also the interjection 'no, no'
drop.N1:おいて/おいて: only met inside において; alone it is 置いて 'leaving'
drop.N1:おおい/おおい: kana alone: heard as 多い 'many' first
drop.N1:我/が: kanji alone reads われ 'I'; が 'ego' only in 我が強い
drop.N1:街/がい: kanji alone reads まち; がい only as a suffix
drop.N1:画/かく: single kanji: alone it is usually が 'picture'
drop.N1:片/かた: a prefix, not a standalone word; also read へん
drop.N1:かつ/かつ: kana alone: heard as 勝つ 'to win' or カツ 'cutlet'
drop.N1:来る/きたる: written alone it reads くる; きたる only before a date
drop.N1:強/きょう: a suffix; the kanji alone suggests つよ-
drop.N1:狂/きょう: a suffix, not a standalone word
drop.N1:故/こ: a prefix; the kanji alone reads ゆえ
drop.N1:さらう/さらう: kana alone: snatch, dredge and rehearse are all common
drop.N1:弱/じゃく: a suffix; the kanji alone suggests よわ-
drop.N1:主/しゅ: single kanji: alone it reads ぬし or あるじ
drop.N1:種/しゅ: single kanji: alone it reads たね 'seed'
drop.N1:称/しょう: not a standalone word for learners
drop.N1:証/しょう: single kanji: rare alone, also read あかし
drop.N1:心/しん: single kanji: alone it reads こころ
drop.N1:粋/すい: single kanji: alone it is usually いき 'chic'
drop.N1:すくう/すくう: kana alone: heard as 救う 'to save' as much as 'to scoop'
drop.N1:先/せん: single kanji: alone it reads さき
drop.N1:角/つの: single kanji: alone also かど and かく, both common
drop.N1:当/とう: a prefix, not a standalone word
drop.N1:人気/ひとけ: written alone it reads にんき 'popularity'
drop.N1:ふける/ふける: kana alone: 老ける, 更ける and 耽る are all common
drop.N1:ブル/ブル: rare clipped form; not a learner word
drop.N1:干し/ほし: not a standalone word; meets learners in 干し物 etc.
drop.N1:ボルト/ボルト: volt and bolt are both common
drop.N1:味/み: a suffix; the kanji alone reads あじ
drop.N1:網/もう: single kanji: alone it reads あみ
drop.N1:薬/やく: single kanji: alone it reads くすり
drop.N1:要/よう: single kanji: alone also かなめ
drop.N1:寄り/より: a sumo term; より is heard as the particle
drop.N1:リート/リート: rare musical term; not a learner word
drop.N3:空/から: 空 alone is read そら (sky) far more often; から would mark そら wrong
drop.N3:直/じき: 直 alone has several common readings (ちょく, じか, すぐ); じき is not how a learner meets it
drop.N3:正/せい: not a standalone word an N3 learner meets; the logic sense is rare
drop.N3:野/の: rare alone; learners meet 野 in compounds
drop.N3:酸化/さんか: technical, not an N3 word; heard, it is 参加 to a learner
drop.N3:縁/ふち: 縁 alone is read えん (bond, fate) at least as often; the edge sense is ambiguous
drop.N3:来/らい: a prefix (来年), not a word on its own
drop.N3:住/じゅう: not a standalone word; met only in compounds like 衣食住
drop.N3:節/せつ: alone it is ambiguous (occasion, section, verse, joint)
drop.N3:なる/なる: kana alone reads as 'to become' (N5); the fruit sense is rare
drop.N3:碑/いしぶみ: reading いしぶみ is rare; learners meet 碑 as ひ in compounds
drop.N3:きり/きり: kana alone is ambiguous (fog, end, only)
drop.N3:出/で: not met alone; a suffix/compound element (日の出)
drop.N3:方/ほう: alone ambiguous: ほう (direction, side) vs かた (person, way)
drop.N3:さる/さる: kana alone is ambiguous with 去る; monkey is written 猿 or サル
drop.N3:ただ/ただ: kana alone is ambiguous (only, free, ordinary)
drop.N3:衆/しゅう: not a standalone word at N3; met in compounds (大衆, 観衆)
drop.N3:供/とも: とも alone is rare; learners meet 供 in 子供, お供
drop.N3:諮る/はかる: rare formal verb (to refer to a committee); not an N3 word
drop.N3:討つ/うつ: literary 'to strike down'; learners meet 打つ
drop.N3:ＯＵＴ/アウト: written in full-width Latin letters; learners meet it as アウト
drop.N3:あら/あら: kana alone: the fish-scraps sense is rare and the interjection is a different word
drop.N3:異/い: rarely a word alone; used in compounds
drop.N3:意/い: rarely a word alone; used in compounds
drop.N3:行けない/いけない: written 行けない it reads as 'cannot go'; the 'bad, must not' sense is written いけない
drop.N3:市/いち: learners read 市 alone as し (city); いち 'market' is rare
drop.N3:いや/いや: kana alone: 'no!' and 嫌 'unpleasant' are both common
drop.N3:上/うわ: a prefix; 上 alone is read うえ
drop.N3:柄/え: learners read 柄 as がら (pattern); え 'handle' is rare
drop.N3:音/おん: learners read 音 alone as おと; おん is in compounds
drop.N3:かかる/かかる: kana alone: 'to take (time), to cost, to hang' are the common senses
drop.N3:角/かく: learners read 角 alone as かど or つの
drop.N3:かく/かく: kana alone: 書く 'write' and 'scratch' are both common
drop.N3:上/かみ: rare sense; 上 alone is read うえ
drop.N3:観/かん: a suffix, not a word alone
drop.N3:関/かん: rarely a word alone; learners meet 関 in compounds
drop.N3:苦/く: rarely a word alone; learners meet 苦しい, 苦い
drop.N3:酌む/くむ: rare; learners meet くむ as 汲む
drop.N3:くわえる/くわえる: kana alone: read as 加える 'to add', the common word
drop.N3:下/げ: rarely a word alone; 下 alone is read した
drop.N3:吝嗇/ケチ: rare kanji spelling; learners know けち in kana
drop.N3:後/ご: 後 alone is read あと or うしろ; ご is a suffix
drop.N3:昨/さく: a prefix, not a word alone
drop.N3:さす/さす: kana alone: 指す, 差す (umbrella) and others are more common
drop.N3:凝と/じっと: rare kanji spelling; learners know じっと in kana
drop.N3:下/しも: rare sense; 下 alone is read した
drop.N3:小/しょう: a prefix, not a word alone
drop.N3:上/じょう: a suffix; 上 alone is read うえ
drop.N3:数/すう: a prefix; 数 alone is read かず
drop.N3:性/せい: alone ambiguous: sex, gender or nature
drop.N3:生/せい: rarely a word alone; 生 alone is read なま
drop.N3:全/ぜん: a prefix, not a word alone
drop.N3:相/そう: rarely a word alone; used in compounds
drop.N3:大/だい: a prefix; 大 alone is ambiguous (だい, おお)
drop.N3:たま/たま: kana alone: 玉 'ball' and 'occasional' are both common
drop.N3:対/つい: learners read 対 as たい; 'pair' is met in 一対
drop.N3:と/と: a particle with many functions; not a card
drop.N3:棟/とう: a counter for buildings; rarely a word alone
drop.N3:音/ね: learners read 音 alone as おと; ね is literary
drop.N3:はあ/はあ: interjection with several senses (yes, huh?, sigh)
drop.N3:敗/はい: a suffix (counting losses), not a word alone
drop.N3:放れる/はなれる: rare spelling; learners know 離れる
drop.N3:分/ぶ: 分 alone is ambiguous (ふん, ぶん, ぶ); the ぶ sense is rare
drop.N3:分/ぶん: 分 alone is ambiguous (ふん minute, ぶん part)
drop.N3:番瀝青/ペンキ: obscure kanji spelling; learners know ペンキ in katakana
drop.N3:方々/ほうぼう: 方々 is also read かたがた 'people', a common sense
drop.N3:ほこり/ほこり: kana alone: 埃 'dust' and 誇り 'pride' are both common
drop.N3:呆んやり/ぼんやり: obscure kanji spelling; learners know ぼんやり in kana
drop.N3:間/ま: 間 alone is usually read あいだ; ambiguous
drop.N3:まく/まく: kana alone: 巻く, 撒く, 蒔く are all common
drop.N3:末/まつ: 末 alone is read すえ; まつ is in compounds
drop.N3:密/みつ: rarely a word alone at this level
drop.N3:むく/むく: kana alone: 向く 'face' and 剥く 'peel' are both common
drop.N3:訳/やく: 訳 alone is read わけ (reason); やく is in compounds
drop.N3:優/ゆう: a grade mark, rarely a word alone for learners
drop.N3:よる/よる: kana alone: 夜, 寄る and 因る are all common
drop.N4:居らっしゃる/いらっしゃる: the kanji spelling is rare; learners meet いらっしゃる in kana
drop.N4:家/か: suffix; the kanji alone is read いえ or うち
drop.N4:君/くん: suffix; the kanji alone is read きみ
drop.N4:すっと/すっと: not an N4 word; the list item is ずっと
drop.N4:町/ちょう: the kanji alone is read まち; ちょう is a suffix
drop.N4:つく/つく: kana alone: arrive, stick and switch on are all common
drop.N4:よう/よう: kana alone: grammar ending with many senses
drop.N5:かける/かける: kana alone: hang, call, put on glasses and sit are all common senses
drop.N5:いる/いる: kana alone: learners know いる as 'to be (animate)', not 要る 'to be needed'
drop.N5:宵/よい: not an N5 word; よい is met as 'good'
drop.N5:やさしい/やさしい: kana alone: 易しい 'easy' and 優しい 'kind' are both N5
drop.N5:そば/そば: kana alone: 'near, beside' and 'soba noodles' are both common
drop.N5:ああ/ああ: kana alone: interjection 'ah' and 'like that' are both common
drop.N5:イクラ/イクラ: wrong word: the N5 item is いくら 'how much', not salmon roe
drop.N5:お/お: a prefix, not a word alone
drop.N5:月/がつ: a suffix; 月 alone reads つき (moon)
drop.N5:がる/がる: a suffix, not an N5 word alone
drop.N5:咖哩/カレー: rare kanji spelling; learners only meet カレー
drop.N5:時/じ: a suffix (o'clock); 時 alone reads とき
drop.N5:中/じゅう: a suffix; 中 alone reads なか
drop.N5:人/じん: a suffix; 人 alone reads ひと
drop.N5:すぎ/すぎ: kana alone: the fish sense is rare; learners meet すぎ as a suffix
drop.N5:そう/そう: kana alone: 'so, like that' and 'seems' are both common
drop.N5:其れから/それから: rare kanji spelling; learners only meet それから
drop.N5:其れでは/それでは: rare kanji spelling; learners only meet それでは
drop.N5:中/ちゅう: a suffix; 中 alone reads なか
drop.N5:日/にち: wrong sense: 日 alone reads ひ (day, sun); Sunday is 日曜日
drop.N5:人/にん: a counter suffix; 人 alone reads ひと
drop.N5:一月/ひとつき: 一月 alone reads いちがつ (January) as often as ひとつき
drop.N5:分/ふん: a counter suffix; reads ぷん after many numbers
